news.title: High number of new directors
news.body: There are 5 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. Additional Director Abdul Shaikh was the last director to join the board, commencing their role in 2026. The company’s lack of board continuity is considered a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.

news.title: Paradeep Parivahan Limited Appoints Abdul Basith Shaikh as Additional Director, Effective April 13, 2026
news.body: Paradeep Parivahan Limited has appointed Mr. Abdul Basith Shaikh (DIN: 11070576) as an Additional Director of the Company with effect from April 13, 2026. Mr. Abdul Basith Shaikh is a dynamic and accomplished business professional with a strong academic foundation in both engineering and management. He holds a B.Tech degree from National Institute of Technology Karnataka and an MBA from Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies, Mumbai. He brings with him over a decade of rich and diverse industry experience, having been associated with JSW Group, Welspun Group, and Tata Steel. Before his appointment, Mr. Shaikh was serving as the Vice President of the Company, where he contributed significantly towards the strategic and operational objectives of the company. news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.5% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk High level of non-cash earnings (38% accrual ratio). news.title: Paradeep Parivahan Limited Approves the of Appointment of Ms. Usha Rani Ray as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, Effective from January 7, 2026
news.body: Paradeep Parivahan Limited at the Board Meeting held on January 7, 2026 approved the of appointment of Ms. Usha Rani Ray (Membership No-ACS 79021) as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer of the Company effective from January 7, 2026.

news.title: Paradeep Parivahan Limited Announces Resignation of Alka Bothra as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, Effective January 7, 2026
news.body: Paradeep Parivahan Limited announced that Ms. Alka Bothra has resigned from the post of Company Secretary & Compliance Officer of the Company with effect from January 7, 2026 due to personal issues and re-location from Bhubaneswar to Kolkata and the same has been accepted by the Board.
